messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — POC update from ACME corp. Their integration using function-calls + JSON mode is intermittently failing. We see valid tool output sometimes, but often the tool response contains trailing garbage and then the client parser errors out. Also hit a couple 429s during load test. Customer is asking for Dedicated pricing and confirmation about data residency/HSM for the security questionnaire. Can eng help triage?

albert_eng: thanks, looking. Do we have the exact payload and the model variant?

maria_sales: sending snippet below from the customer's logs (redacted):

```
REQUEST -> {"input":"summarize","tool":"extractor_v2","call":{...}}
RESPONSE -> {"result":{"items":[{"id":1,"text":"foo"}]}}
}
garbage: \u0000\u0000

ERROR: json.parse failed at pos 234

Also intermittently: HTTP 429 from inference-api.redwood.com/stream (QPS peaked to ~120).

emma_oncall: can you also paste the request headers and model name? 429 suggests client is bursting past rate limit; we may need to engage rate-limiting policy or suggest client-side token bucket.

maria_sales: header: `x-rw-model: gptx-tool-1.0-q8_0` and `x-client-id: acme-1234`. They are doing parallel workers from their side.

raj_eng_ml: that model variant has aggressive quantization path; sometimes it returns extra logits metadata when a tool call hits end-of-sequence quickly — we've seen malformed suffix bytes if streaming buffer flush is concurrent with KV-cache writes.

albert_eng: ok interesting. Two parallel tracks: 1) fix deterministic trimming of streaming tool output so we never append binary/garbage to JSON; 2) mitigate 429s with guidance or temporary capacity bump. For (1) I can push a guard in the streaming assembler to drop non-utf8 suffix and ensure last char is `}` or `]`. Can someone reproduce?

maria_sales: I can get them to run a repro with `DEBUG=rw:stream` logs and share. Customer timeline: they want POC stable by EOW or risk cooling. Pricing ask: they want Dedicated monthly for predictable SLA — can sales confirm ballpark?

sam_sales_ops: ballpark for dedicated pool for this workload (30k tokens/day, sustained) is $Xk/mo — I'll DM legal for exact numbers. For now, tell them reserved capacity starts at 4 GPUs with month-to-month option.

julio_security: on SQ: they asked whether keys can be stored in their HSM with customer-managed KMS and whether logs can be VPC-only. Answer: Private deployments support customer KMS/HSM and VPC private egress, but hosted Dedicated needs to be put on a private network with our VPC-peering addendum. I'll prepare language for the questionnaire. Any specific clauses?

maria_sales: they asked about data residency in eu-west-1 and audit logs retention for 7 years.

julio_security: we can confirm eu-west-1 for Private; Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 for enterprise contracts. 7-year retention is heavy; we usually recommend export-to-customer-archive for long-term retention. I'll add that to the SQ response with options (export, extended retention add-on).

dev-bot: [deploy 1978.3] streaming-fix-guard branch built and queued for canary. CI: ✅ unit, ✅ integration (stream assembler tests).

albert_eng: great — I'll coordinate a quick canary now. Emma, can you add this customer's client-id to the canary target so we can verify without impacting others?

emma_oncall: yes. Added `acme-1234` to canary routing. Also temporarily increased per-client burst token limit to 200 for that client to avoid 429 during repro. Will roll back after verification.

maria_sales: awesome. Customer will repro tonight at 7pm UTC. If we can show clean tool output + stable QPS behavior, they'll sign.

raj_eng_ml: follow-up: if trimming non-utf8 suffix causes data loss for certain tool types, we should instead emit {"_rw_malformed":true,"raw":...} fallback object so parser still receives valid JSON. I'll draft change.

albert_eng: good idea, raj. implement fallback wrapper so user code can detect it. Keep default behavior to strict JSON unless `allow_malformed_tool_fallback=true` in route config.

sam_sales_ops: I'll prepare a short SLA + pricing note and the standard addendum for KMS/VPC. Also looping in finance for an accelerated quote.

julio_security: SQ answer draft ready, posting to the thread after a quick edit.

maria_sales: thanks everyone. After the canary, if green, we need a one-page doc for the customer: steps we took, config they should use (suggested client-side backoff, channeling to single worker for now), and the pricing quote. I'll collate. :thumbsup:

albert_eng: noted. Will keep an eye on logs during the 7pm run. If anything else, ping me.

emma_oncall: monitoring dashboard for `acme-1234`: https://console.redwood/integrations/acme-1234/streams (alerts set).

maria_sales: closing loop — will post customer feedback tomorrow morning. Thanks!
